title: Animal Husbandary Techniques 1 Ruminant
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most common causes of failures in fattening activities.  The objective in a fattening operation is to convert as much of the feed to body tissue as possible."

Underfeeding and incorrect timing are the most common causes of failures in fattening activities.  The objective in a fattening operation is to convert as much of the feed to body tissue as possible.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important management practice for sheep and goat farmers to maintain control of their breeding program and successfully carry out breed improvement."
Castration is an important management practice for sheep and goat farmers to maintain control of their breeding program and successfully carry out breed improvement.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the final product when forage of sufficient moisture (> ~50%) is conserved and stored anaerobically (oxygen-free), under conditions that encourage fermentation of sugars to organic acids."
Silage is the final product when forage of sufficient moisture (> ~50%) is conserved and stored anaerobically (oxygen-free), under conditions that encourage fermentation of sugars to organic acids.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a good medium for bacteria, yeasts and moulds that are the common contaminants."
Milk is a good medium for bacteria, yeasts and moulds that are the common contaminants.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the practice of removing an animal's horns or horn buds, depending on the age of the animal and the stage of horn growth."
Dehorning/disbudding is the practice of removing an animal's horns or horn buds, depending on the age of the animal and the stage of horn growth.
fib: ______ are one of the oldest domesticated species.
Domestic goats are one of the oldest domesticated species.
______ is a subspecies of the wild goat of southwest Asia and Eastern Europe.
The domestic goat is a subspecies of the wild goat of southwest Asia and Eastern Europe.
______ is a strong pole, about 1.5m long, with a hooked end.
A crook is a strong pole, about 1.5m long, with a hooked end.
______ is an essential part of sheep and goat management.
Hoof trimming is an essential part of sheep and goat management.
______ is a process done to identify and track specific animals.
Animal identification is a process done to identify and track specific animals.
